messages:
Mia: heads-up I'm about to open a docs PR that consolidates function/tool calling examples and standardizes on a compact "envelope" response shape. Need a quick schema lint + snippet sync. goal: land before EOD.

Rohit: on it. running schema validator now. will also scan examples for stale anchors.

doc-bot: [auto] jsonschema validate ./content/calling/envelope-example.json -> ERROR: unexpected token at line 18 (trailing comma).

Alyssa: I can patch SDK snippets (js/py). Which param name do we want? `response_mode` or `response_format`?

Mia: prefer `response_format`. final envelope shape is minimal: {"envelope": {"tool": "string", "output": {}}} (I'll add full snippet in PR).

Rohit: pushed tiny fix removing trailing comma (commit be7f2a). re-running validator.

doc-bot: [auto] re-run -> OK: schema valid.

Alyssa: opened PR to update snippets -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5280 (changes client.invoke(..., response_format=\"envelope\") in python & JS).

Mia: thanks! can someone also check the docs anchor for the calling examples? I saw a 404 on docs/faq#tool-call-examples earlier.

Rohit: found link; updated redirects and replaced old anchor with docs/tooling/calling#examples. ran linkcheck locally, no failures.

Mia: great. plan: wait for snippets PR to merge, then run a staging docs deploy (small). Who will run staging?

Alyssa: I can kick off the staging deploy once my snippets PR is merged.

Mia: perfect. final ask: add a short migration note to CHANGELOG/docs under "Docs" about envelope -> compact shape. I'll include brief example.

Rohit: added changelog entry in main PR (commit be7f2a -> be7f2b). CI green.

Mia: thanks all :rocket: will merge after staging smoke is confirmed. Leaving thread open for any last-minute fixes.
